statement.p: Compute the derivative of the given function. f(t) = \sqrt[5]{t}(\tan t - 2 e^{0.9 t}).

static.solution:
Solution:
Use the Product Rule. \begin{array}{rcl} f'(t) \amp =\amp \displaystyle \sqrt[5]{t} \frac{d}{dx}[ \tan t - 2 e^{0.9 t} ] + \frac{d}{dx}[\sqrt[5]{t}] (\tan t - 2 e^{0.9 t}) \\ \amp \amp \\ \amp =\amp \displaystyle \sqrt[5]{t} (\sec^2 t - 1.8 e^{0.9 t}) + \frac{1}{5}t^{-4/5} (\tan t - 2 e^{0.9 t}) \end{array}
